arguments.question: Assess ANET's operating outlook and valuation for the 5/21/63-session research mandate. Use SEC facts/filings plus the dated Q2 2026 results and Q3 guidance and timestamped analyst-consensus source. Build one explicit bear/base/bull company grid and, because this is a single-company expert mandate, calculate forward P/E, EV/revenue, and five-year DCF outputs in one three-method analysis. State fiscal period/share basis, residual EPS bridge against reported interim EPS and management guidance, fixed-input reverse expectations/break-even EPS and P/E, and all assumptions. Analyze AI networking demand, customer concentration, competition, supply, margins, cash generation, and distinguish company guidance from third-party consensus. Deliver concise factual, inferential, and scenario claims plus observable reversal conditions. Stop after the registered sources and at most one clearly material discovered company document; report any unavailable timestamped consensus rather than estimating it.
arguments.decision_impact: Determines whether operating execution and three valuation methods justify conditional upside/downside ranges, while preventing hypothetical scenario asymmetry from being mistaken for a probability or recommendation.
